title: Detect Pattern of Length M Repeated K or More Times
summary: Given an array of positive integers, determine if a subarray of length m is repeated at least k times consecutively without overlap.
statement: Given an array of positive integers, determine if a subarray of length m is repeated at least k times consecutively without overlap. Return true if such a pattern exists, otherwise return false.
constraints: Find a length-m block repeated k times consecutively without gaps or overlap.
Return whether any such starting position exists.
hints: Compare each value with the value m positions earlier.
Repeating a block k times creates exactly m*(k-1) such comparisons.
Reset on mismatch; reaching the threshold proves one uninterrupted repeated region.
editorial: Reset on mismatch; reaching the threshold proves one uninterrupted repeated region.

tests.explanation: The value four repeats in at least three consecutive length-one blocks.
No length-two block repeats twice consecutively.
